D: A teenage Peter Parker gets his powers and goes after a scientist who turns himself into a giant lizard.
P: Serve the mains when Peter sits down to dinner with Gwen's family.
S: Baked egg muffins with cheddar, spring onion and ham
Eggs whisked with cheddar, spring onion and diced ham, poured into a muffin tin and baked at 180C for 15 minutes until puffed and set.
Puff pastry rolls with pizza sauce, pepperoni and mozzarella

Golden puff pastry spirals rolled with pizza sauce, pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano, baked until crisp, with warm marinara for dipping. Spread 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry with 4 tbsp pizza sauce, leaving a 1cm border. Scatter with 100g sliced pepperoni, 150g grated mozzarella and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes, then cut into 2cm slices. Lay cut side up on lined trays, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until golden. Serve with 250ml warmed passata.
M: Brisket braised in red wine, stock and tomato paste, roast carrots

Beef brisket braised for hours in red wine and sweet onions until it slices like butter, with honey roast carrots and the braising gravy. Brown a 1.5kg brisket, then soften 3 sliced onions. Add 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock and 2 tbsp tomato paste and braise covered at 160C for 3.5 hours. Roast 6 carrots for the last 40 minutes and slice the meat across the grain.
dinner at home with Aunt May

Beef and pork meatloaf with onion and herbs, brushed with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, baked and sliced thick over buttery mash. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, parsley and salt. Press into a loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp mustard and spread on top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml warm milk. Slice the meatloaf thick over the mash.
W: Soft vanilla cookies iced in two colours, half and half

Big soft cake-like vanilla cookies iced half in white lemon icing and half in glossy chocolate, the New York bakery classic. Beat 120g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 150ml milk and vanilla, then 300g self-raising flour. Spoon 12 rounds onto trays and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Ice half of each with white icing and half with icing mixed with 2 tbsp cocoa.
K: Gwen's dark hot chocolate with marshmallow
Hot milk whisked with dark chocolate, cocoa and vanilla, marshmallows on top

Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with vanilla and a pinch of salt, whisked frothy and topped with toasted marshmallows. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Take off the heat and whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 1 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 mugs. Top each with 3 large marshmallows and toast them with a kitchen blowtorch or under a hot grill for 30 seconds.
